request.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished FULLSCREEN QUEST-SELECTION WINDOW concept for our OWN existing isometric fantasy game, opened by clicking the city temple mage. One landscape16:9 full-screen UI mockup, not a poster, not multiple variants, not a screenshot claimed to be implemented.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is our OWN APPROVED research-window style reference: use its Lunar Porcelain warm ivory surfaces, dark plum text/header, thin bronze/silver sculpted panel borders, tiny turquoise fittings and elegant plum action buttons. DO NOT copy its research content, inventory grid or resource/time row. Image2 is our OWN APPROVED temple mage: long silver-white hair and beard, ivory/plum/gold ceremonial robe and gold cross staff. Derive a compact head-and-shoulders portrait, keep his identity. Image3 is our OWN APPROVED orc and purple ogre appearance: use these two enemies in separate quest thumbnails, do not redesign them or mix them into one encounter. This is original own-project art, no external game copying.
LAYOUT at roughly1600x900: fullscreen warm-ivory background, full-width dark-plum navigation bar at top about70px. Preserve these familiar nav labels ONLY: «Инвентарь I», «Исследования P», «Развитие героя O», «Карта M», «Esc · Закрыть». No new quest shortcut and no additional global tab.
Below navigation a clean service heading row down to abouty190: large title at left EXACTLY «Задания храма»; at right an approximately80px circular portrait medallion of approved mage, with title «Храмовый маг». Not a giant character-art column. No invented personal/city name, dialogue quote or religious lore.
MAIN CONTENT TWO COLUMNS ONLY atx48…1552,y210…820, gap28px. Left panel about430px wide, right panel uses remaining width. Warm-ivory interiors and restrained fine Lunar Porcelain metallic framing. Avoid excessive ornament behind letters. Realistic consistent padding24–28px, aligned baselines, generous text contrast. No element outside its frame.
LEFT PANEL title exactly «Доступные задания». Exactly TWO matching broad horizontal quest cards of EQUAL height and width, sensible gaps. First selected card: small painted portrait of the olive orc, title «Лагерь орков». Cyan accent is a thin selection border, not an opaque blue fill. Second card: small painted portrait of the PURPLE ogre, title «Стоянка огров», normal neutral border. Two visually distinct locations/quests, no orc-ogre mixed camp, no goblin/undead third entry, no invented difficulty/level/status/rank/reward icons. Empty space below is calm porcelain, no fake locked quest rows.
RIGHT PANEL: selected quest title «Лагерь орков» as a strong readable heading. Under it a WIDE SHALLOW artwork band: the same approved olive orc in a simple wooded clearing, reference-style soft painted volumes. Moderate height, not a giant new environment painting or new camp blueprint. Keep it entirely inside the panel. Then clearly separated readable sections: heading «Цель» and body EXACTLY «Победить орков в лагере»; heading «Место» and body EXACTLY «Лагерь орков». No arbitrary kill counter, no0/10, no numeric level, no distance or map route. One large well-crafted dark-plum gold/ivory-edged action button anchored inside lower-right panel reading EXACTLY «Принять задание».
FOOTER below both panels: one quiet centered hint EXACTLY «Esc · Вернуться в игру».
STRICT CONTENT CONSTRAINTS: NO reward section, gold, XP, currency values, resource wallet, wood/stone/metal, numeric day/HH:MM clock, bottom gameplay HUD/minimap, Active/Completed/Claim tabs, reward button, global quest hotkey, reputation/faction, dialogue choices, goblins, undead or bosses. No developer notes, placeholders, lorem ipsum, illustrative watermarks or extra text. Objective wording is illustrative content only, no gameplay implementation claim.
STYLE: faithful to Image1's refined light-ivory/plum fullscreen fantasy UI, balanced usable proportions, slightly dimensional sculpted narrow borders, readable Russian type with safe spacing, cyan used ONLY for selected quest. A finished attractive interface proposal that looks like another window in the same game.
